title: check.finished v1
description: A rule check row gets its result. Codes only: the checker's reason is text and stays on the rule_checks row.

hook.description: The hook the check ran at.

rule_version_id.description: The rule version the check ran against.

effect.description: For applied, the policy's effect; else null.

wait_cause.description: Why the wait_ready step this event opens is waiting: credential_limit when no seat is eligible only because no candidate is available and none is signed out, else null. Null when the event opens no wait_ready step. Fixed when the step opens (PRD, Rules for steps, rule 8).

subject_kind.description: The kind of the check's subject: seat at task.before_claim and review.assign, question at question.asked, action at action.requested, review at review.failed, event at cost.reported; null at a hook with no subject (L408).

input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the hook's hashed inputs in lower-case hex (Gating.input_hash). With task, rule version, hook, round and subject it is the check's identity (L408, L771), so replay into empty tables can insert the rule_checks row.
